describe: The image shows a UV texture sheet for a character, with labelled pieces laid out on a grey background. The top left holds a helmet and face with red eyes, and there are green-grey torso, leg and arm pieces, khaki and ochre glove and shirt pieces, dark jaw and neck pieces, and a small framed photograph at the lower right. Black text labels name each part. Colours are muted green-grey, khaki and ochre with dark metal details. The pieces are opaque, and the gaps are grey transparent background.
